observation_summary: The compiler failed to generate a warning when a class implemented an interface but provided a property with an incompatible type, specifically for data members defined on the interface prototype.
reasoning_summary: The bug was a missing capability in the type-checking system to validate interface property types for implemented classes. The fix involved moving the diagnostic logic from the local TypeCheck class to the TypeValidator class and implementing the missing validation logic for interface property mismatches. This represents a design-level capability correction rather than a local algorithmic fix or a simple guard.
evidence_used: The bug report states 'Add support for data members on interfaces'.
The fix involved moving the HIDDEN_INTERFACE_PROPERTY_MISMATCH diagnostic from TypeCheck to TypeValidator.
The fix added new logic in TypeValidator to retrieve and compare property types between the instance and the interface, which was previously absent.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the fix involves code logic, it is fundamentally about adding a missing validation capability to the type system's design, not correcting an existing algorithm's execution.
The fix is not just adding a missing guard to existing code, but implementing a new validation feature that was entirely absent from the interface implementation check.
